note: Relay Strike (Suleiman's spec). When a push, pull or shove leaves a foe standing next to one of your units, that unit gets a free hit.
text: Relay Strike: when a foe is pushed and stops next to an ally, that ally strikes it for free (60 percent damage, full if the foe is Off-Balance). One per ally per round, two at most per push (the second hits at half strength). Not if the ally is in a clash, stunned or meditating, or cannot reach the foe. Works for both sides.
